overview_description.description: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database management system that focuses on real-time analytical reporting. It enables users to execute complex SQL queries efficiently, making it suitable for applications that require fast data processing and analysis. The system is particularly effective for big data environments, allowing organizations to manage and analyze large volumes of information seamlessly. ClickHouse supports various data ingestion methods and offers features that facilitate data warehousing and observability. Its architecture is designed to optimize performance and scalability, catering to the needs of sales teams and data analysts seeking actionable insights from their data.

product.name: ClickHouse
product.description: An open-source, column-oriented OLAP database for real-time analytical queries over large datasets using SQL.

product.name: ClickHouse Cloud
product.description: A fully managed ClickHouse service hosted on AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure for scalable real-time analytics.

product.name: Bring Your Own Cloud
product.description: A managed ClickHouse deployment installed in a customer’s own AWS or Google Cloud account.

product.name: ClickStack
product.description: An open-source observability stack for collecting, storing, and querying logs, metrics, traces, and session replays with ClickHouse.

product.name: Postgres managed by ClickHouse
product.description: A managed PostgreSQL service that combines transactional workloads with ClickHouse analytics in a unified data stack.

product.name: ClickPipes
product.description: A ClickHouse Cloud data ingestion service for moving data from external systems into ClickHouse.
